interpretation.base: Deep copy of st_measure_contract.json revision 2, not the predecessor contract.
interpretation.counterfactual: ST-02 explicitly overrides only the baseline relation a=d+3 with a=d+2 for hypothetical evaluation. Its a and observation_power change together. The baseline source and stale expected_algebra stay unchanged.
interpretation.diagnostic_names: Proposal-local expected messages, not new scientific-status vocabulary.
interpretation.expected_values: Manually transcribed from the adopted brief and personally read source; not observed runtime results.
interpretation.patch: Object-member JSON Pointer overlay only: apply all set entries, then all remove entries. No patch runner is included.

patch_semantics.failure: Any invalid pointer, absent parent, non-object parent or conflicting target refuses the whole case; do not retain a partial overlay.
patch_semantics.order: All set entries precede all remove entries. Distinct targets must not equal, contain, or be ancestors of one another, so within-stage order is irrelevant.
patch_semantics.pointer_syntax: Nonempty slash-prefixed JSON Pointer; decode ~1 as slash and ~0 as tilde; reject other tilde escapes.
patch_semantics.remove: Delete an existing terminal member; absence is an input error.
patch_semantics.set: Add an absent terminal member or replace an existing terminal member with the supplied JSON value; do not deep-merge the value.
patch_semantics.status: This is a declared inert-case interpretation, not an implemented patch library or extension of evidence_adapter v1.
patch_semantics.targets: Only object members. All ancestor object members must exist; no array indices or implicit parent creation.

interpretation.request_fields: Added instance_role, counterfactual_relation and requested-reporting/conversion fields are case-overlay metadata, not changes to the closed production adapter schema.

selection.rule: The selector must match the selected object kind. Unknown or missing selector, member or kind is an input error; no implicit default.
